definitions.explanation: Of exceptionally high quality or ability; excelling in a particular area.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{学生|がくせい}です。
{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{成績|せいせき}で{卒業|そつぎょう}した。
{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{人材|じんざい}を{採用|さいよう}したい。
examples.english: We want to hire outstanding talent.

notes:
USAGE: {優秀|ゆうしゅう} is used to describe people, work, or results that are notably superior to others. It's commonly used in academic and professional contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{学生|がくせい} (excellent student)
・{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{成績|せいせき} (excellent grades)
・{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{人材|じんざい} (outstanding talent)
・{優秀|ゆうしゅう}{賞|しょう} (excellence award)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{優|すぐ}れた - excellent, superior
・{立派|りっぱ} - splendid, admirable
